## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Introduced a new state-vectors module providing standardized data structures for state transition handling and binary serialization.

* **Refactor**
  * Consolidated state transition types and codecs into a dedicated external package for improved modularity and reusability across the codebase.

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Walkthrough

The PR extracts state-vector types and codecs into a new package packages/jam/state-vectors and adds it to the monorepo workspaces. It introduces exported classes StateKeyVal, TestState, StateTransitionGenesis, and StateTransition (with FromJson and Codec implementations). Multiple modules (bin/convert, bin/lib, bin/test-runner and others) now import these types from @typeberry/state-vectors instead of local definitions; package.json files were updated to depend on the new package and bin/lib re-exports the module. One loadState signature was adjusted to accept the external StateKeyVal form and map to internal tuples.

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~25 minutes

- Review FromJson schemas and Codec implementations in packages/jam/state-vectors/index.ts for correctness and compatibility with existing encoders/decoders.
- Verify updated import paths in bin/test-runner and bin/convert resolve correctly and do not create circular dependencies.
- Check the changed loadState signature and the conversion from StateKeyVal[] → [key, value][] for edge cases (null/undefined values, expected lengths).
- Confirm package.json/workspace updates and new dependency versions are consistent across affected packages.

## Possibly related PRs

- FluffyLabs/typeberry#523 — touches the same state-vector types (StateKeyVal/TestState/StateTransition) that are centralized here.
- FluffyLabs/typeberry#477 — refactors TestState/StateKeyVal/StateTransition implementations which overlaps with extracting them into a shared package.
- FluffyLabs/typeberry#510 — modifies state-loader API and TestState handling; directly related to the loadState signature and type changes in this PR.
